cases.description: Actual career output passes the existing exact evidence and canonical output validator.
Actual action-plan output passes its existing lineage, resource, scenario and SDG validators.
Every actual career citation resolves to its frozen permitted exact excerpt.
Protected persisted programme and all-course inventories agree across phases.
Actual competency states match explicit fictional assessed, intended, partial, audited and unknown labels.
Title-only inventory course supplies no positive competency finding.
Documented fictional learning intent is not promoted to demonstrated attainment.
Generated action plan is proposed, without academic approval or implementation authority.
Two distinct conditional assumptions remain non-forecasts without probability.
Any source-admitted SDG relation remains possible contribution without measured impact.
Actual occupations and their reviewed fixture requirements retain exact skill labels.
Replace one real output citation quote; actual career validator must reject it.
Promote unknown competency to unsupported elective proposal; canonical validator must reject.
Assign an unregistered skill to an actual requirement output; typed source validation must reject.
Change the output programme revision while retaining frozen evidence.
Change a consideration review content version; exact version validation must reject.
Give a list in place of the academic programme UUID; Pydantic must reject.
A model-style instruction masquerading as an academic recommendation cannot pass canonical validation. This tests output rejection, not model prompt resistance.
A replacement claim inserted in recommendation text cannot pass canonical validation.
A fabricated unrelated SDG target cannot replace the frozen admitted mapping.
Forged academic approval must be rejected.
A scenario cannot claim predictive probability.
Actual API revalidation must redact results after source withdrawal.
Actual API revalidation must invalidate modified source content/version.
Actual duplicate submission/explicit repeat maintains frozen result consistency.
Actual contradictory admitted curriculum assertions must not become supported or confirmed gap.
Actual stale workforce context must retain date limitations without new demand claims.
Actual document-instruction fixture must preserve admitted facts and review boundaries.

limitations: All academic and occupation examples are fictional; classification labels are engineering fixture expectations, not external academic expert judgements.
Permitted authentic benchmark sources may be reused unchanged; their provenance and synthetic flags remain distinct.
Output-mutation rejection demonstrates validator behaviour, not live model factuality or prompt-injection resistance.
Replay checks are only counted when the integration runner supplies actual observations; unexecuted checks are explicitly not_observed.
No paid model/search requests are performed. No inference about real university curricula, graduates, labour-market accuracy or achieved SDG impact follows.
